snippet.title: RitualRX - Demo Reveal Teaser
snippet.description:
⛤--------------------------------------------------------------⛤

THE HEAVENS ARE EMPTY, 
HUMANITY IS UNRESTRAINED, 
THE PARTY WILL NEVER STOP.

⛤--------------------------------------------------------------⛤

The FREE DEMO for Ritual RX drops June 8th, 
Get your prescription today and wishlist RitualRX on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3443710/RitualRX

Interested in learning more about the game? Join the Discord server:
https://discord.gg/SE6nwVZxsE

Features VITAMASS by @Rudolve 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wyDhqHXRH48&list=OLAK5uy_ni-XYOZvK9B8hOTuHOdNQqIQJ1T3TrKVE&index=8

⛤--------------------------------------------------------------⛤

RitualRX is a brutally violent, blisteringly fast, adrenaline-pumping shooter set within a pastel paradise ruled by cults. Control a group of excommunicated sinners as you shoot, slash, and slaughter your way through a city where ritual is prescribed and the only treatment administered is an overdose of lead.
